text: Auto-pick the single best chart type from the picker matrix and state both Chart choice and Why this chart before or inside the deliverable.
Output MUST be a single self-contained HTML5 file built from assets/shell.html with zero external CDN script or stylesheet URLs.
Every diagram MUST embed a single declarative CHART_SPEC (states, transitions, rules, demoSequence) driving both the playable stage and the Show the logic drawer.
Provide Play, Step, Reset, event trigger buttons, and clickable/keyboard-focusable nodes updating an aria-live="polite" status readout.
Include a Show the logic toggle button (aria-expanded) revealing synchronized Rules and a Logic Flowchart.
Every primary <svg> MUST declare numeric viewBox, role="img", aria-labelledby, <title>, <desc>, and keep <text> labels inside safe margins.
Support Light and Dark themes (:root, [data-theme="dark"], prefers-color-scheme: dark, and a theme toggle button) with readable contrast.
Honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and keep responsive layout free of horizontal overflow at 1440px and 390px.
Never invent unstated rules or numbers; when a prompt gives no subject, workflow, or rules, ask 1-2 short clarifying questions and output no HTML.
Refuse out-of-scope requests (static spreadsheet pie/bar charts, figure-craft, svg-mechanism, motion-craft, ui-craft) in one concise sentence with no HTML.
Verify rendered output via engine/lint-chart.mjs and Playwright/browser checks at 1440px and 390px in light, dark, and reduced-motion modes.
checklist: Rendered HTML passes engine/lint-chart.mjs (C1-C8) and browser checks at 1440px and 390px across light, dark, and reduced motion.
